column1: # The modes shirabe's decider declarations ship with: one row per declared
# value. scripts/check-decider-declarations.sh fails when a template's
# effective mode for a value (shadow when the template sets none) differs from
# its row here, when a declared value has no row, or when a row names a value
# no template declares. Promoting a value means editing its mode in the
# template and here, in the same change.
# Columns, tab-separated: template path, state, field, value, mode.
